name: orthomcl-more-proteins-in-one-genome-than-another
turns: Find orthogroups with more proteins in Toxoplasma ME49 than Plasmodium 3D7.
rationale: A per-group comparison of two genomes' protein counts is a sum of products over every count the smaller side takes: the 3D7 genome with exactly k proteins and the ME49 genome with at least k+1, for k from 0 to the largest 3D7 count any group holds, joined by OR. The k = 0 product keeps the groups with no 3D7 protein.
